resources.string: Sign in with your work email
Accounts are created by your organisation

There is no self-signup. Your organisation’s admin creates your account and shares a temporary password with you — you’ll be asked to set your own at first login.\n\nNew company? The platform team sets up organisations.
Hi, could you please create a YuviPep account for me? My work email is:
You’re using a temporary password. Choose a new one to continue.
You’re offline — showing your last known session
Your session ended. Please sign in again.
%1$s is coming in a future update. Your work stays safe on the server in the meantime.
Platform operators cannot read organisation data.
Your cached data on this device will be wiped.
Anything that concerns you lands here — approvals, tasks, replies, escalations.
This opens fully in a later phase — the work item is safe on the server.
That’s the whole digest — the summary is right here in the notification.
Approvals, assignment confirmations and reviews will appear here the moment they exist.
The AI has matched people to tasks — review the reasons and confirm.
The AI couldn’t place these — attach or mark them handled.
When the AI needs your sign-off, it lands here.
Queued — will apply when you’re back online
To change this draft, reject it with a note describing the change and the AI will redraft it.
Someone decided this one, or it expired. Nothing is waiting on you here.
When the AI proposes who should do what, the batch appears here.
Changing the person needs the staff directory, which your role can’t read. Confirm as proposed, or reject via your admin.
Edit or drop anything the AI got wrong — nothing goes live until you confirm.
%1$d task(s) are live. The Planner is building the plan from this meeting — the project and its approvals will appear shortly.
Add an item the AI missed
⚠ Looks like “%1$s”%2$s — drop if it’s the same
This meeting has no extracted items waiting.
Messages the AI can’t place will wait here for a human.
This file has no leads to import.
Try clearing the filters, or create one with the button below.
A name of at least 2 characters is required.
Your role can view leads but not change them — ask a sales colleague.
Kept as is. The suggestion stays on the server until the state changes; this banner won\'t show again for it.
What did you learn about this client?
Nothing here yet — facts appear as the AI and your team learn about this lead.
No contacts yet. Add one or scan a business card.
No projects for this lead yet.
No notes yet. Anything you save here also feeds the AI\'s memory of this client.
No meetings yet. Record one or type the notes.
The scan was unclear — verify these details. No message will go to this contact until a human saves them (the server enforces this too).
An intro message to %1$s was drafted — it is waiting in Approvals, nothing was sent.
Check the details below. An intro message will be drafted from what you save — nothing has been queued yet.
Fill the frame with the card
Camera permission was declined — you can add the contact manually instead.
Before recording, confirm the client agreed to it. This is stored with the lead (DPDP).
Microphone permission was declined — typed notes work just as well.
Recording — the screen can be turned off
Delete this recording without uploading? This cannot be undone.
Recording continues in the background — the notification takes you back.
Tap to return to the recorder
Upload failed — the backend refused the file.
The pipeline failed without a reason string.
The transcript confidence was low — double-check anything important against your memory of the meeting.
The AI suggests marking this lead \'%1$s\' — accept or keep it on the lead screen.
The pipeline finished without extracting anything actionable. The transcript is stored with the meeting.
Add an item the AI missed

The Planner reads these notes exactly like a recording\'s transcript: it extracts tasks, updates plans and drafts follow-ups — everything lands as approvals or reviewable items, nothing is sent by itself.
The Planner is reading your notes…
Write at least a sentence or two.
The Planner finished but reported no detail.
Hello %1$s — tell me what you need. I can draft and send proposals, book follow-ups, answer questions… anything client-visible waits for your approval.
The request did not go through — your text is back in the box, tap send to retry.
It still has blanks the AI left to fill in: %1$s\n\nAsk the assistant to fill them in, or reject it with a note so it gets redrafted. If you send it now, the client sees them exactly as they are.
Nothing has been drafted or sent yet — pick one, or type your answer.
I need one more detail before I can do this.
No AI decision is recorded for this record.
Machine-generated from the pricing table — words are editable, numbers are not.
This really emails the client from your address. Check the recipient.
That is not a valid email address
CC entry \"%1$s\" is not a valid email
Say what to change in plain words. Prices and totals stay locked — the pricing table owns them.
e.g. make the tone warmer and shorter
Say a little more about the change you want
This section could not be written from what is on record. Fill it in before sending.
Projects appear once a deal is agreed or the Planner proposes one from a meeting.
This project has no linked lead to record a meeting against.
Nothing to show on this project yet.
No tasks on this project yet.
Nothing has happened on this project yet.
Pick a contact for this lead first
This lead has no contacts yet — add one from the lead\'s Contacts tab first.
Your role can\'t manage the project team — ask your operations lead or org admin.
Say a little more about the resolution
Nothing happened this week, or the project is on hold — no report generated.
Queued for approval before it reaches the client.
Commercials stay on this parent project; each branch gets its own lead record and delivery plan.
This project is already a branch of another — chain deals start from the top-level project.
New tasks show up here the moment they\'re assigned.
This task was found outside its project, so some detail (priority, dependencies, blocked state) isn\'t available here.
no one else found — your phase lead has been notified
Blocked — nudges paused until you unblock.
Blocked — %1$s has been told and will see it on Home.
This breaks: %1$s — sent to your phase lead to confirm instead.
This device has no microphone — typing works everywhere.
Allow microphone access, then tap the mic again.
Didn\'t catch that clearly — check the text and send it yourself.
Jarvis will forget what you have said so far in this chat. Your leads, tasks and drafts are not affected.
New chat started here, but the old one could not be deleted on the server — it will go on its own within 90 days.
Rescheduled — the updated invite is drafted and waiting in Approvals.
Cancelled — the retraction is drafted and waiting in Approvals.
Your role can\'t update demos — ask your operations team.
Your role can\'t book demos — ask your operations lead or an admin to book it for you.
A date is needed to book.
The calendar invite is drafted and waiting in Approvals — nothing has been sent yet.
Follow-ups appear here as meetings and messages create them.
Nothing you have sent matches this filter. Try “Whole organisation”.
Nothing in the organisation matches this filter.
Nothing has happened to this message yet.
Open the message that was sent
Could not read the saved message: %1$s
Attachments are not listed here — the server does not return them with a message. The saved copy above includes them.
Set what it is asking for
The AI could not tell what this is asking for.
A contact at %1$s — this is how the message finds its client.
Client identified — you can reply from here.
There are no clients to attach this to yet.
There are no projects to attach this to yet.
%1$s has no contacts yet, and a message is attached through the person who sent it. Add a contact on the client first, then come back.
Attach it to a client first
The assistant writes on behalf of a client relationship, so it needs to know whose message this is before it can draft a reply.
Draft an email to %1$s at %2$s replying to their question: %3$s
Draft an email to %2$s replying to the question they sent from %1$s: %3$s
A call or a message that reached you outside the system. It goes through the same understanding and routing as an email that arrived on its own.
Choose who this came from first.
Type or dictate what they said.
That contact has no address for %1$s.
No contact at %1$s has an address to receive this on.
Could not load agents — this lead will be yours
%1$s owns this lead and has not opened it yet. Meetings and projects unlock once they do.
You own this lead. Open it once a call goes well — meetings and projects unlock then.
This marks the lead as lost for now. It stays on record and can be revived later.
The work is finished. A relationship manager keeps in touch from here and tells you when they are ready to buy again.\n\nLeaving this client closed is fine too.
There are no relationship managers set up yet.
The ones who have not heard from us in a while come first.
When a sale finishes, the owner can hand the client to you. They will appear here.
They may be ready to buy again

Accepting tells every sales lead so one of them can pick it up. The client stays with you until a new round actually starts. Dismissing records that it was not real, which is how the assistant learns.
There are no sales agents to assign this to.
The summary is on the client record. No tasks were created — this was a conversation, not a job.
The summary is on the client record. Suggested next touch: %1$s
You can interrupt Jarvis by talking. Turn this off if Jarvis starts answering itself.
Jarvis finishes speaking before listening again. Tap stop to cut it short.
A meeting is being recorded — voice mode can\'t use the microphone until it stops.
Your session has expired — please sign in again.
Edit what I heard and tap send, or just say it again.
heard by voice — not sure I got it right
not acted on — I wasn\'t sure what I heard
%1$s is saved and starts in cold calling. Tap to open it.
Nothing is created until you say so.
End voice mode and go back to the chat
Hi! I\'m listening — ask me anything, or say \"create a lead named…\".
%1$s. Download this face to talk with it; swipe to meet the others.
This phone can\'t show faces, but Jarvis will speak in %1$s\'s voice.
Another face is still downloading — try again when it\'s done.
